candidate_archives_state_fields.name: candidate_archives_state_fields
candidate_archives_state_fields.value: ("candidate_archives"."state"='closed' AND "candidate_archives"."finalPairId" IS NULL AND "candidate_archives"."mutationGeneration" IS NULL AND "candidate_archives"."conversationGeneration" IS NULL AND "candidate_archives"."completedAt" IS NULL) OR ("candidate_archives"."state"='complete' AND "candidate_archives"."finalPairId" IS NOT NULL AND "candidate_archives"."mutationGeneration">0 AND "candidate_archives"."conversationGeneration">0 AND "candidate_archives"."completedAt" IS NOT NULL)

candidate_capacity_claims_state_fields.name: candidate_capacity_claims_state_fields
candidate_capacity_claims_state_fields.value: ("candidate_capacity_claims"."state"='live' AND "candidate_capacity_claims"."releasedAt" IS NULL AND "candidate_capacity_claims"."evidence" IS NULL) OR ("candidate_capacity_claims"."state"='released' AND "candidate_capacity_claims"."releasedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "candidate_capacity_claims"."evidence" IS NOT NULL)

candidate_continuations_state_fields.name: candidate_continuations_state_fields
candidate_continuations_state_fields.value: ("candidate_continuations"."state"='pending' AND "candidate_continuations"."messagesDigest" IS NULL AND "candidate_continuations"."readyAt" IS NULL) OR ("candidate_continuations"."state"='ready' AND length("candidate_continuations"."messagesDigest")=64 AND "candidate_continuations"."readyAt" IS NOT NULL)

candidate_restore_barriers_state_fields.name: candidate_restore_barriers_state_fields
candidate_restore_barriers_state_fields.value: ("candidate_restore_barriers"."state"='closed' AND "candidate_restore_barriers"."restoredPairId" IS NULL AND "candidate_restore_barriers"."fallback" IS NULL AND "candidate_restore_barriers"."conversationGeneration" IS NULL AND "candidate_restore_barriers"."completedAt" IS NULL) OR ("candidate_restore_barriers"."state"='complete' AND "candidate_restore_barriers"."restoredPairId" IS NOT NULL AND "candidate_restore_barriers"."fallback" IS NOT NULL AND "candidate_restore_barriers"."conversationGeneration">1 AND "candidate_restore_barriers"."completedAt" IS NOT NULL) OR ("candidate_restore_barriers"."state"='refused' AND "candidate_restore_barriers"."restoredPairId" IS NULL AND "candidate_restore_barriers"."fallback" IS NULL AND "candidate_restore_barriers"."conversationGeneration" IS NULL AND "candidate_restore_barriers"."completedAt" IS NOT NULL)

session_commands_target_shape.name: session_commands_target_shape
session_commands_target_shape.value: ("session_commands"."kind" = 'project_delete' AND "session_commands"."targetKind" = 'project' AND "session_commands"."sessionId" IS NULL AND "session_commands"."commandSeq" IS NULL) OR ("session_commands"."kind" != 'project_delete' AND "session_commands"."targetKind" = 'workspace_session' AND "session_commands"."sessionId" IS NOT NULL AND "session_commands"."commandSeq" IS NOT NULL AND typeof("session_commands"."commandSeq") = 'integer' AND "session_commands"."commandSeq" > 0)

session_commands_message_shape.name: session_commands_message_shape
session_commands_message_shape.value: ("session_commands"."kind" IN ('prompt', 'follow_up') AND "session_commands"."userMessageId" IS NOT NULL AND "session_commands"."assistantMessageId" IS NOT NULL) OR ("session_commands"."kind" NOT IN ('prompt', 'follow_up') AND "session_commands"."userMessageId" IS NULL AND "session_commands"."assistantMessageId" IS NULL)

session_commands_run_shape.name: session_commands_run_shape
session_commands_run_shape.value: ("session_commands"."kind" IN ('follow_up', 'stop') AND "session_commands"."targetRunId" IS NOT NULL AND "session_commands"."targetCommandId" IS NULL) OR ("session_commands"."kind" = 'cancel' AND "session_commands"."targetRunId" IS NULL AND "session_commands"."targetCommandId" IS NOT NULL) OR ("session_commands"."kind" NOT IN ('follow_up', 'stop', 'cancel') AND "session_commands"."targetRunId" IS NULL AND "session_commands"."targetCommandId" IS NULL)
